name: Death
overview: Scripture reveals that death entered the world as a direct consequence of disobedience to God's command, as seen in Genesis 2:17 where death is promised upon eating from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. Humanity's mortality is underscored in Genesis 3:19, which reminds us that man was formed from dust and will return to dust. Yet, death is not merely an end but a transition, as illustrated by Enoch's unique departure in Genesis 5:24, where God took him rather than allowing death in the usual sense. The Bible also portrays death as a solemn reality affecting all creation, with God's judgment leading to destruction as in Genesis 6:7, but also offers hope of peaceful rest and being gathered to one's ancestors, as expressed in Genesis 15:15.
